data.long_description:
City Walk is more than just a place to live—it’s a thriving community where luxury seamlessly blends with nature, offering residents a lifestyle full of incredible experiences. This is your chance to own a home in one of Dubai’s most sought-after developments!

Fern Central Park at City Walk brings a new standard to urban living with its perfect mix of luxury, convenience, and community. The meticulously designed apartments are surrounded by lush greenery, offering a peaceful retreat just minutes from the city’s vibrant heartbeat. Enjoy breathtaking skyline views while living a life of sophistication.

At Fern City Walk, every detail is crafted with your comfort in mind. Spacious layouts flood with natural light, creating homes that feel both warm and inviting. Residents have access to world-class amenities including a fully equipped gym, pristine swimming pools, and dedicated children’s play areas. The development also prioritizes sustainability, with abundant green spaces that promote an active, healthy lifestyle. Scenic walking paths and landscaped gardens provide the ideal sanctuary from the energy of the city.
